dz: 王满巩固了自己在中国的权力,被封为"元帅". 汉武帝爱帝,前日已死,无后嗣.
de: Wang Mang consolidates his power in China and is declared marshal of state. Emperor Ai of Han, who died the previous day, had no heirs.
